verdict.rationale: Bento documents AI-driven insights from your own trace data inside the product. It clusters similar findings so patterns surface on their own, pinpoints what shifted when agent behavior drifts, and judges alert incidents real or benign. For suggestions, it proposes trigger-based fixes that are scored in shadow mode before promotion, and it keeps a plain-language memory of failure patterns and fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing and docs), and in-depth documentation of how the generated fix suggestions are presented and reviewed in the dashboard.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Similar findings group into clusters, so patterns surface before you go looking.
